description: Read the traveler's favorite places: the lists they keep in their Augmap account, and their organizations' lists, each place with place_id, point and its notes: why it was saved and by whom. Every list is summarized on every page; places come a page at a time (next_cursor until null).

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; pass the same near, radius_km, list_id and owner.

limit.description: Places per page across the lists, default 100.

list_id.description: Read only this list (a list_id from an earlier map_favorites).

near.description: Keep only favorite places within radius_km of this point.

owner.description: With list_id: whose list, "you" or the org_id in that list's owner. list_id is unique per owner, so pass owner as map_favorites returned it.

place_id.description: With list_id: read only this place, with every one of its notes (a page shows the first 3 and notes_total).

radius_km.description: With near: the distance, default 25 km.

name: map_favorites
title: Read favorites
